title: DriverQueueAdapter
responsibility: Read live worker task files and re-verify plans, excluding running and completed work, and infer current model capacity.

inputs.name: DriverQueueAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: Optional driver root, status directory and injected slot-process inventory. Defaults use the established component-pyramid results and code-phase status directories.

inputs.name: DriverQueueAdapter.render.state
inputs.description: Active driver snapshot to render. Adapter render defaults to a fresh read; dead PIDs are filtered by active(), not by the formatter.

outputs.name: DriverQueueAdapter.active
outputs.description: Driver snapshot with dead PIDs removed, current model counts and recalculated nonnegative remaining totals; source files stay unchanged.

outputs.name: DriverQueueAdapter.read
outputs.description: Queue snapshot reconstructed from live slot tasks, result-file completion markers, active starts and the reverify plan; includes inferred capacity and provenance warnings.

outputs.name: DriverQueueAdapter.render
outputs.description: ACTIVE.md-compatible text for the supplied state or a fresh active snapshot; does not write ACTIVE.md.
